title: Quiz: design
description: Three questions on design, accessibility and motion.

questions.question: Your text is cut off at large text sizes. What is the likely cause?

answers.text: A fixed frame or font size, or an HStack that should become a VStack

questions.why: Let text wrap and layouts adapt.

questions.question: What should you do when Reduce Motion is on?

answers.text: Replace large movements with fades, or remove the animation

questions.why: Movement can make some people feel unwell.

questions.question: What is the minimum comfortable size for a touch target?
questions.why: That is Apple's guideline for reliable tapping.
